Weddings at Bentley Hotel

Your ceremony and reception under one roof

For weddings of 4 to 100 guests, with evening receptions for up to 120.

Start your wedding enquiry 01698 265588

Congratulations

Your day, the way you want it

All of us at Bentley Hotel would like to congratulate you on your forthcoming wedding and wish you the very best for your future together.

Bentley Hotel is an ideal venue for both the ceremony and the reception. Our function suite offers comfortable, air-conditioned private dining, and our conservatory suits a smaller wedding party.

We can offer an extensive choice of services and menus, or our experienced team can design your wedding around your own needs and preferences. We understand that your day deserves to be the very best, and we’d be delighted to share in your celebrations and make sure everything runs smoothly.

We’re always happy to advise on, or talk through, anything that will add to your day.

The wedding package

Designed to make your day as stress-free as possible

Our wedding package takes care of the details, so you can enjoy the day with the people who matter most.

Packages and prices are tailored to each wedding. Get in touch for current details and available dates.

  • An overnight stay in the hotel for the couple
  • Fresh floral arrangements for all guest tables
  • Personalised menus and table plan
  • Use of our wedding cake stand and knife
  • A late licence until 1am

The venue

Everything in one place

The function suite

Comfortable, air-conditioned and exclusively yours, for the wedding breakfast and an evening reception for up to 120.

The conservatory

A light-filled space beside the house, ideal for smaller, more intimate wedding parties.

In-house catering

Our own kitchen prepares your wedding meal, with a choice of menus or a menu built around you.

Rooms for your guests

Eighteen en-suite bedrooms, so family and friends can stay over and enjoy breakfast the morning after.

Easy to get to

Free on-site parking, and Motherwell station is around 5 minutes’ walk for guests coming by train.

A dedicated team

Our team will guide you from your first visit to your last dance, with individual attention throughout.

From the ceremony to the morning after

How your day could run at Bentley Hotel

Every wedding is different, so think of this as one way a full day here can unfold. If you’d rather hold just the meal, just the evening, or a small gathering in the conservatory, we’ll shape the day around that instead.

  1. The ceremony

    If you’d like to marry at the hotel

    Ask us about ceremonies when you enquire. We’ll talk you through where in the house a ceremony could take place, how the room would be set out and what needs to be arranged in advance. If you’d like somewhere to get ready beforehand, mention that too.

  2. Drinks

    A welcome in the conservatory

    After the ceremony, or as your guests arrive from a ceremony held elsewhere, gather for a drink in the conservatory while the photographs are taken.

  3. The meal

    Your wedding breakfast in the function suite

    Sit down together in the air-conditioned function suite, which seats up to 100 for a wedding breakfast. Your personalised menus and table plan, and fresh floral arrangements on every guest table, are part of our package.

  4. The evening

    A reception for up to 120, until 1am

    Evening guests join you for the reception, with room for up to 120 and a late licence until 1am. Cut your cake using our cake stand and knife, then dance until the end of the night.

  5. Overnight

    Your room at the hotel

    An overnight stay for the couple is included in our package, so when the last guests head home you’re already home for the night. Family and friends can stay too, in our 18 en-suite bedrooms.

  6. Next morning

    Breakfast with the people who stayed

    Our full Scottish breakfast is cooked to order, so there’s time to catch up with the guests who stayed over before everyone heads off. We’ll confirm what your overnight stay includes when we plan your wedding, and for guests booking their own rooms the booking confirmation shows whether breakfast is included.

Small weddings

Small weddings and intimate days

We’re pleased to host wedding parties of any size, from just 4 guests upwards, and a small wedding gets the same care as a large one.

For an intimate day, our conservatory is ideal: a bright glass room on the side of the house where a few close family and friends can sit down together for a wedding meal. The function suite is there if your numbers grow, or if you’d like a bigger evening celebration after a small ceremony and meal.

Ask us which parts of our wedding package suit a smaller day, and tell us if anyone is travelling to be with you so we can talk through rooms for them.

Ask about a small wedding
  • A wedding meal in the conservatory for your closest family and friends
  • A quiet ceremony for a few guests, if you’d like one here: ask us about ceremonies
  • A drink together before or after the meal
  • Menus talked through with you, including allergies and dietary needs
  • Rooms in the hotel for anyone travelling to be with you
  • The option of a larger evening reception in the function suite
One team plans your wedding with you and looks after it on the day.

Planning with us

Five steps from first enquiry to the big day

Most couples arrive with a date, a rough number and a few firm ideas. That’s plenty to start with, and we’ll help you settle the rest.

It usually helps to see the rooms first and then settle the menu, the table plan and the timings over the following weeks or months. Whatever stage you’re at, a call or an enquiry is the place to start.

Reception only, or evening only? The same steps apply. Just tell us which parts of the day you’d like to hold with us.

  1. 1

    Get in touch

    Send us your date, or a few dates you’re considering, and rough numbers for the day and the evening. We’ll come back to you with availability and how to go about holding your date.

  2. 2

    Visit and view

    Come and see the function suite and the conservatory, walk through how your day could run, and ask us anything you like.

  3. 3

    Talk through menus

    We’ll talk through menus with you: choose from our range or ask us to design something around you. This is also the time to tell us about allergies and dietary needs, and whether children will be eating with you.

  4. 4

    Table plan and details

    Your table plan, personalised menus, timings, the cake, your music and the rooms your guests will need. We’ll confirm the arrangements with you so everyone knows what’s happening when.

  5. 5

    The day itself

    We set up the suite, welcome your guests and look after the running of the day, from the first drink to the last dance, so you can enjoy it.

Your guests

Easy to reach, and room to stay

A wedding brings people from all over. Bentley Hotel is at the west end of Motherwell, a short walk from the station and the town centre, and between Glasgow and Edinburgh, so your guests can arrive by train or by car and stay the night under the same roof as you.

18 en-suite rooms

Singles, twins, doubles and family rooms for up to 3, each with a TV, tea and coffee making facilities and free WiFi. See the rooms.

Free parking

Free on-site parking for guests arriving by car. Motherwell is just off the M74 at junction 6 (A723), with the M8 a few miles north.

5 minutes from the station

Guests arriving by train are about 5 minutes’ walk from the station, with Glasgow Central under 20 minutes away.

Between two cities

Glasgow is about 12 miles away and Edinburgh about 30. Glasgow Airport is roughly 30 minutes by car and Edinburgh Airport roughly 45. Getting here.

Holding rooms for your guests? Tell us roughly how many of your guests expect to stay when you enquire, and we’ll explain how to reserve rooms for them and how they can confirm their own bookings.

Other celebrations

Before the wedding, and long after it

The same rooms, kitchen and team look after the celebrations that come either side of the big day.

Engagement parties

Gather both families for a meal or an evening party in the function suite or the conservatory, and get to know the venue before your wedding.

Anniversaries

A dinner for two in the restaurant, a family meal in a private space, or a party for everyone who was there the first time.

Renewing your vows

If you’re renewing your vows, ask us about marking the day here with a celebration meal, with rooms for family travelling to join you.

Birthdays, christenings and other functions

Before you get in touch

What helps us help you

Tell us what you already know about the day, and we’ll help with the rest.

Send the details through our wedding enquiry form, or call us on 01698 265588 and talk it through.

Send a wedding enquiry
  • Your date, or a few dates you’re considering
  • Numbers for the day and for the evening
  • Whether you’d like a ceremony at the hotel, or a reception only
  • Roughly how many bedrooms your guests might need
  • Allergies and dietary needs you already know about
  • Anything else that matters to you: children, access needs, music, timings

Wedding questions

Can we have our ceremony and reception at Bentley Hotel?

Yes. Bentley Hotel is a venue for both the ceremony and the reception. Tell us what kind of ceremony you have in mind when you enquire, and we’ll talk you through where it could take place and what needs to be arranged.

How many guests can you host?

We can host wedding parties of 4 to 100 guests, and evening receptions of up to 120. For smaller weddings, our conservatory is ideal; for larger ones, the air-conditioned function suite is exclusively yours.

Can we hold just the wedding meal, or just the evening reception, with you?

Yes. Some couples marry elsewhere and come to us for the meal, others hold a small ceremony and meal and then invite more guests for the evening. Tell us which parts of the day you’d like to hold here and we’ll plan around that.

Can our guests stay at the hotel?

Yes. We have 18 en-suite bedrooms, from singles to family rooms sleeping up to 3. Ask us about reserving rooms for your wedding guests when you enquire, and we’ll explain how they can confirm their bookings.

How late can the celebrations go on?

Our wedding package includes a late licence until 1am.

Can you cater for dietary requirements?

Yes. Our kitchen will talk through allergies, intolerances and dietary requirements for you and your guests when we plan your menu. Tell us too if children will be eating with you, and let us know about any requirements as early as you can.

Can we come and see the venue before we decide?

Of course. Call us on 01698 265588 or send an enquiry and we’ll arrange a time to show you the function suite and the conservatory and talk through your plans.

Can we bring our own cake, band or photographer?

Yes. Our cake stand and knife are part of the package, ready for the cake you bring. Tell us who you’re working with for music, photography and anything else, and we’ll make sure they know where to go and what time to arrive on the day.

Let’s talk about your wedding

Tell us your date and guest numbers, and we’ll be in touch with availability and details.
